inferred_table_pii_exposure.risk: MEDIUM-HIGH — RPT_NEW_HIRES is a denormalized snapshot that co-locates employee name, hire date, job title, location, employment type, and base salary in a single row. This is more sensitive than the individual OLTP tables because salary is joined directly to name without requiring a multi-table query. Access must be restricted to Grade >= 5 (consistent with REPORTING - View standard reports in access-control-matrix.md) or Grade >= 8 if the salary column is treated as payroll data.
inferred_table_pii_exposure.access_gap: No explicit access control row exists for direct SELECT on RPT_* tables in access-control-matrix.md. If any Oracle Reports .rdf or BI tool queries RPT_NEW_HIRES directly (bypassing PKG_REPORTING.new_hires_report which enforces no access check itself), salary data would be readable by anyone with schema access.
inferred_table_pii_exposure.da_source: ADDED from PKG_REPORTING.pkb analysis — RPT_NEW_HIRES salary PII not previously inventoried
